# Worker CA (mTLS)

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:worker-mtls` · **Epic:** [#87](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/87) · **Tickets:** 6 (2S 4M)

Replaces per-worker bearer tokens with short-lived mTLS client certificates issued by a CP-held intermediate CA. Workers enroll once with a single-use token, then renew automatically; operators revoke a worker by revoking its cert.

## How we build it

- CP intermediate CA: key stored via secrets.SecretStore (`warden/cp/ca/intermediate`), cert chain configured by `workerCA.certFile` (operator signs it offline from their root, or `proxy control-plane ca init` creates a self-signed root+intermediate for dev).
- Enrollment: admin creates a single-use token (random 32 bytes, stored hashed, TTL 1h, bound to a worker id) in the console; worker calls `POST /enroll` with token + CSR (ECDSA P-256), gets a 24h cert with URI SAN `spiffe://<trust-domain>/warden/worker/<id>`, ExtKeyUsage clientAuth.
- Renewal: `POST /enroll/renew` authenticated by the current cert, new CSR, at 2/3 lifetime (16h); expired cert requires re-enrollment.
- CP TLS listener uses tls.VerifyClientCertIfGiven with the intermediate pool; /policy, /control/heartbeat, /central/ingest, /central/secrets require a verified worker cert whose SPIFFE id is not revoked; the console and /oauth2/token stay cookie/assertion-authenticated.
- Revocation: `worker_certs` table (serial, worker id, not_after, revoked_at); revoked serials (unexpired only) shipped in the signed bundle and checked by CP on every request.
- Per-worker tokens from P1 accepted only while `workerAuth.legacyTokens: true` (default false after migration), then removed.

## Done when

A fresh worker enrolls with a one-time token, runs for over 24h renewing automatically, is cut off within one request after its cert is revoked, and per-worker tokens are disabled.

### 1/6 · W-P2-WCA-01

**Add internal/workerca intermediate CA and cert issuance**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#88](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/88)

Create new package internal/workerca with `CA.Issue(csr *x509.CertificateRequest, workerID string, ttl time.Duration) (*x509.Certificate, error)` that validates the CSR signature and key type (P-256 or Ed25519), ignores CSR-requested SANs, and sets the SPIFFE URI SAN, clientAuth EKU, 24h validity and 5m backdate. Add `proxy control-plane ca init` to generate a dev root+intermediate; store the intermediate key via secrets.SecretStore. Reuse loadCA patterns from internal/controlplane/tls.go.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Issued cert has exactly one URI SAN with the configured trust domain
- [ ] CSR with RSA-1024 rejected
- [ ] Intermediate private key never written to CP state dir

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-KEYS-02`](key-management.md#25--w-p2-keys-02) Persist signing keys in secret backend with metadata in CP SQLite

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-WCA-02`](worker-mtls.md#26--w-p2-wca-02) Add enrollment tokens and POST /enroll endpoint

### 2/6 · W-P2-WCA-02

**Add enrollment tokens and POST /enroll endpoint**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#89](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/89)

Add `enrollment_tokens` table (hash, worker_id, created_by, expires_at, used_at) and admin API/UI to create a token (shown once). `POST /enroll` with JSON {token, csr} verifies the token in constant time, marks it used in the same transaction, issues the cert and records it in `worker_certs`. Audit `worker.enrolled`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Reused token returns 401
- [ ] Expired (>1h) token returns 401
- [ ] Successful enrollment returns cert + chain PEM and records serial

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WCA-01`](worker-mtls.md#16--w-p2-wca-01) Add internal/workerca intermediate CA and cert issuance; [`W-P2-AREG-02`](agent-registry.md#24--w-p2-areg-02) Expose agent registry admin API with role checks and audit

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-WCA-03`](worker-mtls.md#36--w-p2-wca-03) Add worker enrollment and auto-renew client; [`W-P2-WCA-04`](worker-mtls.md#46--w-p2-wca-04) Require mTLS on worker-facing CP routes

### 3/6 · W-P2-WCA-03

**Add worker enrollment and auto-renew client**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#90](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/90)

In internal/worker add an enroller: on first start with `--enroll-token-env` generate a P-256 key (state dir, 0600), POST /enroll, persist cert; then a renewer goroutine calls `POST /enroll/renew` at 2/3 lifetime with jitter and swaps the in-memory cert used by GetClientCertificate. Renewal failure retries with backoff; if the cert expires the worker keeps last-known-good policy and logs an error.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Restart reuses the persisted cert without re-enrolling
- [ ] Fake clock: renew fires at ~16h
- [ ] Expired cert keeps enforcing last-known policy

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WCA-02`](worker-mtls.md#26--w-p2-wca-02) Add enrollment tokens and POST /enroll endpoint

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-WBND-05`](identity-enforcement.md#55--w-p2-wbnd-05) Use worker mTLS client cert for all CP calls

### 4/6 · W-P2-WCA-04

**Require mTLS on worker-facing CP routes**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#91](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/91)

Configure the CP server TLS with ClientAuth=VerifyClientCertIfGiven and the intermediate pool; add middleware in internal/controlplane that, for /policy, /control/heartbeat, /central/ingest and /central/secrets, requires a verified cert, extracts the SPIFFE worker id (replacing the self-reported X-Warden-Proxy-ID for registry tracking) and checks the revocation table. Keep P1 per-worker tokens behind `workerAuth.legacyTokens`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Request without cert to /policy returns 401 when legacyTokens=false
- [ ] Registry lists the worker by SPIFFE id
- [ ] Console routes still work without a client cert

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WCA-02`](worker-mtls.md#26--w-p2-wca-02) Add enrollment tokens and POST /enroll endpoint

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-WCA-05`](worker-mtls.md#56--w-p2-wca-05) Implement worker cert revocation

### 5/6 · W-P2-WCA-05

**Implement worker cert revocation**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#92](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/92)

Add `POST /api/workers/{id}/revoke` (admin) that sets revoked_at on all unexpired certs for the worker, audits `worker.revoked`, and triggers a bundle refresh so the revocation list (serials until not_after) is shipped to workers. The mTLS middleware rejects revoked serials immediately.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Next request from a revoked worker returns 401
- [ ] Revoked serial appears in the next signed bundle
- [ ] Expired serials are pruned from the list

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WCA-04`](worker-mtls.md#46--w-p2-wca-04) Require mTLS on worker-facing CP routes

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-WCA-06`](worker-mtls.md#66--w-p2-wca-06) Retire per-worker tokens and document migration; [`W-P2-SECT-04`](security-tests.md#44--w-p2-sect-04) Add worker cert and signed bundle attack cases
